purpose: Separate pre-registration DRAFT for DYNAMIC chunking and HCA. This is a hypothesis-driven design record, not a runnable confirmation: the fixed-chunk v5 study will consume the WikiText-103 test slice, so a second study on the same rows is not independent. The draft names (H1) segmentation quality, (H2) retrieval precision and (H3) long-range coverage as separate claims, and schedules the dedicated controls needed to attribute a gain to the boundary mechanism rather than to dense-vs-sparse budget differences. Freeze only after a disjoint test corpus (or never-read document split) is reserved, the realized dynamic block length is measured to calibrate the matched fixed top-k, and the pre-test power gate passes. v6-v11 results are exploratory and may not be quoted as evidence for this draft.
training_recipe: Same 3000-step / seq 512 / batch 12 recipe as v5: 18.4M consumed tokens per run over the same 8M-token train cache, identical data order per seed. EVERY arm uses RoPE (rope=True, rope_dim=16, qk_norm=True); mixing the non-rope csa_dynamic_task with rope arms is forbidden because positional encoding would be a second factor. No arm may early-stop: a shortened run changes the token budget and cannot enter a budget-controlled contrast. The dynamic arms add the boundary policy knobs (target_block_tokens, temperature, comp_lambda, boundary_policy); all knobs are tuned on validation with the same declared grid before any disjoint test read.

test_slice.loader: a disjoint corpus or a row-offset slice never read by v5

binding.per_arm_recipe_signature_note: All sparse/dynamic arms stay at mr=4.0 so the boundary/selection contrast does not also change MLP width. full_rope is widened to the v5 parameter proxy; full_rope_sink subtracts the 48 sink parameters. The ledger verifies the totals before any test access.

read_budget_binding.note: Analytic read budget only. The realized mean dynamic block length must be measured on validation before the matched fixed top-k is frozen.

primary_comparisons.name: H3 dynamic-vs-fixed (learned selection) @ L4096 (draft)
primary_comparisons.interpretation_caveat: Read budget is an analytic proxy until the realized dynamic block length is measured; do not call this read-matched yet. Also confounds boundary policy with learned selection unless paired with the random-vs-random segmentation control.

primary_comparisons.name: H3 read-matched fixed vs dynamic (PPL) @ L4096 (draft)
primary_comparisons.interpretation_caveat: This is the H3 long-range-coverage contrast: dynamic reads vs a concrete FIXED arm whose top-k is calibrated from the measured realized dynamic block length. topk32 is only the current candidate; after calibration replace the arm name with the calibrated csa_fixed_rope_topk{k}. The analytic target_block_tokens proxy is not a read-budget match.

primary_comparisons.name: H1 segmentation-only (random selection) @ L4096 (draft)
primary_comparisons.interpretation_caveat: Both arms use a seeded random selector, so this isolates the boundary mechanism; promotion still requires the measured read-budget calibration and a matched fixed top-k.

primary_comparisons.name: H2 selection-only (dynamic blocking) @ L4096 (draft)
primary_comparisons.interpretation_caveat: Both arms use the same dynamic cuts and top-k, so only the selector differs; the NIAH endpoint and the top-1/random floors are reported together.

primary_comparisons.name: H4 task-learned boundary vs cosine @ L4096 (draft)
primary_comparisons.interpretation_caveat: The task-learned policy trains the cut sampler with the LM loss; the cosine arm trains only the compression-regularizer offset. This is a boundary-policy contrast, not a boundary-geometry or read-budget contrast.

primary_comparisons.name: H1 boundary quality at matched read budget @ L4096 (draft)
primary_comparisons.interpretation_caveat: The concrete fixed top-k must be re-derived from the measured dynamic block length before freezing; topk32 is only the initial candidate, not a frozen matched budget.

primary_comparisons.name: H5 system-level HCA-dynamic vs CSA-dynamic @ L4096 (draft)
primary_comparisons.interpretation_caveat: HCA reads every closed block and is NOT read-budget matched; this is a system-level hierarchy readout, never a boundary/selection mechanism claim.

primary_comparisons.name: H3 parameter proxy: dense vs dynamic @ L4096 (draft)
primary_comparisons.interpretation_caveat: The dense arm is parameter-matched by MLP widening, not compute/read matched; it is a system-level reference, not the mechanism control.

statistics.test: exact two-sided sign-flip over paired per-seed deltas
statistics.min_seeds_note: with 16 frozen seeds and an 8-comparison Holm family, 12 complete pairs already give a minimum attainable Holm p of 0.00390625 < 0.05; the shipped confirmation must still require all 16 seeds (complete coverage, no top-up)
statistics.power_note: Before any disjoint test read, simulate the exact sign-flip over the calibration per-seed delta vector; if power at q=0.95 is below 0.8, add seeds and record the revision BEFORE the read. The symbol-test projection is only a rough design aid.
statistics.decision_rule: DRAFT: not active. Once frozen, CONFIRMED requires status=frozen, a disjoint test source never used for selection, a passed pre-test power gate, complete 16-seed coverage, p_holm<0.05, direction matching the pre-registered sign, matched token/parameter/read budgets (measured calibration for dynamic-vs-fixed), and mechanism_claim_allowed=true only for a single-factor contrast.
statistics.seed_policy: seeds 0-15 are frozen for this draft; no seeds may be added after the first disjoint test read (selection bias by construction). Missing seeds are reported as unincluded, never topped up.

power_projection.method: equal-magnitude symbol-test projection via exp_lib.signflip_power; not the exact sign-flip power for unequal deltas
power_projection.source: design projection at the frozen n/m/q; before freeze replace it with the exact sign-flip simulation on the calibration per-seed delta vector

boundary_f1.note: H1 primary endpoint; macro over sequences, matched-length random baseline reported alongside

niah.note: H2 primary endpoint with trivial floors; not folded into the PPL Holm family

scope.confirmatory_claims: DYNAMIC chunking and HCA only, after this draft is frozen and the disjoint-source preconditions are met
scope.not_covered: fixed-chunk selection/sink claims are covered by confirmation_frozen.json, not here; dense-vs-sparse compute claims are not covered here either
scope.required_for: a disjoint test source, a new freeze, a measured dynamic-block-length read-budget calibration, a pre-test power simulation and the same strict admission/freeze-lock machinery as v12
scope.mechanism_claim_policy: Only H1 segmentation-only (random-vs-random), H2 selection-only (dynamic blocking) and H4 task-policy contrasts are eligible for a mechanism claim, and only after the read-budget calibration; H3/H5/dense comparisons are system-level.

precondition.test_source: FineWeb-Edu (preferred) or a disjoint WikiText-103 document split
precondition.disjoint_test_source: FineWeb-Edu (preferred) or a disjoint WikiText-103 document split
precondition.must_not_reuse: results_lm_test rows 0-47 reserved for the fixed v5 study; no v6-v11 validation row/arm selection may be reused as evidence
precondition.why: a second confirmation on the same test rows is not independent; the first read fixes the slice and the freeze lock only protects that manifest

read_budget_calibration.source: validation measurement of the realized mean dynamic block length
read_budget_calibration.rule: freeze the concrete csa_fixed_rope_topk{k_fixed} arm after measurement

power_gate.method: exact sign-flip simulation on the calibration per-seed delta vector

selection_provenance.v6_v11: exploratory; selected on the same validation split; never evidence for this draft
selection_provenance.dynamic_arms: design hypotheses fixed BEFORE any dynamic run

status_note: DRAFT ONLY. `v12_supp.py dynamic-plan` audits this file and refuses structural defects. Even with V12_ALLOW_DRAFT=1 this file is not a confirmation; the fixed v5 test rows must never be reused, and no dynamic/HCA result may be written as confirmatory until every precondition above is met.

evidence_policy.explicit_rule: A draft/exploratory result can never be promoted by a smaller p-value, a new endpoint, or a post-hoc arm. Promotion requires a new frozen manifest, a disjoint test source, complete seed coverage and the pre-test power gate.
evidence_policy.v6_v11_status: exploratory (selected on the same validation split used for analysis)
evidence_policy.v12_fixed_chunk_status: confirmatory only for confirmation_frozen.json, not this file
evidence_policy.new_comparison_rule: Every new comparison must name hypothesis_id, endpoint, evidence_level, expected_sign and its dedicated control before any GPU run.

H1_segmentation_quality.statement: Dynamic boundaries improve segmentation quality: at matched token, parameter and read budgets, dynamic cuts align with reference boundaries more often than fixed cuts, and the gain survives when both arms use the same (random) block selector.
H1_segmentation_quality.mechanism: Cosine low-similarity transitions place cuts between units that should not be compressed together, reducing cross-boundary compression error.
H1_segmentation_quality.falsifier: Dynamic cuts do not beat fixed cuts on matched-length boundary F1 after Holm correction, or the gain disappears in the random-vs-random segmentation-only contrast.

H2_retrieval_precision.statement: At the same top-k read budget, learned selection over dynamic blocks retrieves the answer-bearing block more often than a seeded random selector over the same dynamic blocks, and its retrieval advantage is not explained by extra parameters or read slots.
H2_retrieval_precision.mechanism: Query-conditioned indexer scores identify the dynamic block that contains the far key/value instead of spending the budget on arbitrary blocks.
H2_retrieval_precision.falsifier: The seeded random selector matches or beats learned selection on the NIAH/selection endpoint after Holm correction, or the contrast is within seed noise.

H3_long_range_coverage.statement: Dynamic blocking improves long-range coverage: at matched token, parameter and read budgets it lowers L4096 PPL versus a read-matched fixed blocking arm, not merely versus dense attention.
H3_long_range_coverage.mechanism: Adaptive cuts avoid diluting a fixed read budget over irrelevant fixed-length blocks, so more of the selected budget carries content needed at long range.
H3_long_range_coverage.falsifier: The read-matched fixed arm matches or beats the dynamic arm after Holm correction, or the L4096 gain reverses at L512.

H4_task_policy.statement: The LM-trained boundary policy lowers L4096 PPL versus the cosine threshold + compression-regularizer-only policy at the same read budget.
H4_task_policy.mechanism: The LM objective can trade compression against language-modelling loss directly, whereas the cosine threshold optimizes a segmentation surrogate.
H4_task_policy.falsifier: The task-trained policy matches or loses to the cosine policy after Holm correction, or its seed variance makes the panel unusable.

H5_hca_hierarchy.statement: Alternating dynamic CSA and HCA layers lowers L4096 PPL versus dynamic CSA only at matched training tokens and parameters.
H5_hca_hierarchy.mechanism: Local HCA layers and sparse dynamic CSA layers cover complementary short- and long-range structure.
H5_hca_hierarchy.falsifier: The hybrid matches or loses to CSA-only after Holm correction, or the contrast is confounded by HCA reading every closed block.

token_budget.rule: all arms consume steps*bs*seq_len = 3000*12*512 = 18,432,000 tokens from the same 8M-token cache and data order

parameter_proxy.rule: full_rope matches csa_fixed_rope total parameters; full_rope_sink subtracts only the 48 sink parameters
parameter_proxy.not_compute_matched: parameter matching reallocates MLP width; it does NOT match FLOPs or attention reads

token_matched_arm.rule: the fixed reference consumes the same 18.4M tokens as every dynamic arm
token_matched_arm.check: token budget equality is verified by comparison_budget_ledger before any run

dense_token_matched.rule: the parameter-proxy dense arms consume exactly the same steps*bs*seq_len tokens from the same 8M-token cache and data order as every CSA/HCA arm; parameter matching is a separate, explicit reallocation of MLP width
dense_token_matched.not_read_matched: parameter/token matching does NOT match FLOPs or attention reads; use the read_budget control for a mechanism claim

calibration.source: measured realized mean dynamic block length on the validation split
calibration.rule: k_fixed = round(topk_dynamic * mean_dynamic_block_tokens / fixed_block_size); train the concrete csa_fixed_rope_topk{k_fixed} arm and record the measurement in this manifest before freezing

selection_control.purpose: separate learned selection from boundary policy inside each blocking mode; both arms use the same number of read blocks

segmentation_control.purpose: hold the selector random in BOTH arms so fixed-vs-dynamic isolates the boundary mechanism instead of boundary + learned selection

hca_control.purpose: HCA reads every closed block, so this is a system-level hierarchy readout, not an equal-read mechanism control
hca_control.claim_scope: system-level only; never a boundary/selection mechanism claim

budget_controls.dedicated_control_rule: a mechanism claim is allowed only with matched tokens, matched parameters and a matched/read-calibrated budget plus one of the dedicated controls above; "vs dense" alone is never sufficient
